events.title: Telford United's FA Cup ends in a 3–2 defeat to 더비 카운티 in their fourth round clash at the Baseball Ground . 토트넘 홋스퍼's hopes of winning the FA Cup for a record eighth time are ended by a 2–1 defeat to 노리치 시티 at Carrow Road . In the First Division, 리버풀 sustain their lead of the league with a 3–0 win over 왓퍼드 at Anfield.
Media mogul Robert Maxwell , who already owns Third Division promotion challengers 옥스퍼드 유나이티드 , is reported to be on the verge of taking over 맨체스터 유나이티드 in a deal worth up to £10million.

Leaders 리버풀 are held to a goalless draw by 선덜랜드 in the First Division at Roker Park . 맨체스터 유나이티드 fail to close the gap at the top when 노리치 시티 hold them to a goalless draw at Old Trafford, although third-placed 웨스트햄 유나이티드 take advantage of the top two's failure to win by beating 스토크 시티 3–0 at Upton Park. 노팅엄 포리스트's title hopes are hit by a 2–2 draw at home to 토트넘 홋스퍼. Fifth-placed QPR keep up the pressure on the leading pack by beating 아스널 2–0 at Highbury. The top four sides in the Second Division are all in action today. 셰필드 웬즈데이 are held to a goalless draw by 블랙번 로버스 at Ewood Park , allowing 첼시 to extend their lead at the top of the table with a 3–1 home win over 허더즈필드 타운. 맨체스터 시티 are held to a 1–1 draw by 그림즈비 타운 at Blundell Park , allowing fourth-placed 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 to draw level on points by beating 포츠머스 4–1 at Fratton Park . Grimsby are now fifth and looking like serious contenders for promotion to the First Division, in which they last played just after the Second World War .
질링엄's hopes of ousting 에버턴 from the FA Cup are ended when the Merseysiders win the FA Cup fourth replay 3–0.

월솔 hold 리버풀 to a 2–2 draw in the League Cup semi-final first leg at Anfield. In the First Division, their lead of the First Division stands at four points after 맨체스터 유나이티드 are held to a 2–2 draw at 버밍엄 시티. Third-placed 웨스트햄 유나이티드 also drop points, being held to a 1–1 draw by QPR at Loftus Road .
Midweek drama in the First Division sees 노팅엄 포리스트 win 5–0 away to 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 to go second in the league and three points behind 리버풀. 토트넘 홋스퍼 beat 선덜랜드 3–0 at White Hart Lane.

리버풀 remain top of the First Division with a 2–1 home win over 아스널. 노팅엄 포리스트 keep up the pressure with a 1–0 away win over QPR, as do 웨스트햄 유나이티드 with a 2–1 away win over 코번트리 시티. 토트넘 홋스퍼 continue to close in on the top five with a 3–2 home win over 레스터 시티. 왓퍼드's revival continues as they climb up to 11th with a 5–3 away win over 노츠 카운티.

Bryan Robson and Norman Whiteside score twice and Frank Stapleton is also on the scoresheet as 맨체스터 유나이티드 beat 루턴 타운 5–0 at Kenilworth Road. The result means that United are now four points off the top of the table, and also deals a major blow to Luton's hopes of qualifying for the UEFA Cup just two seasons after being promoted.

리버풀 reach the final of the Football League Cup for the fourth year in a row after a 4-2 aggregate victory over Third Division 월솔 . In the First Division, QPR remain firmly in the top five with a 2–0 home win over 노리치 시티.
에버턴 beat 애스턴 빌라 2–0 in the League Cup semi-final first leg.
사우샘프턴 beat 블랙번 로버스 1–0 in the FA Cup fifth round at Ewood Park.

First Division 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 suffer a shock FA Cup exit at the hands of Third Division strugglers 플리머스 아가일 , who win 1–0 in the fifth round match at The Hawthorns . 웨스트햄 유나이티드's double hopes are ended when they lose 3–0 to 버밍엄 시티 at St Andrew's . 에버턴's cup adventures continue on both fronts as they beat 슈루즈버리 타운 3–0. 노츠 카운티 beat 미들즈브러 1–0 at Meadow Lane. 셰필드 웬즈데이 triumph 3–0 away to 옥스퍼드 유나이티드. 왓퍼드 beat Brighton 3–1 at Vicarage Road . In the First Division, 아스널 draw 1–1 with 애스턴 빌라 at Highbury and 스토크 시티 win 3–2 at 코번트리 시티. The top three of 리버풀, 맨체스터 유나이티드 and 노팅엄 포리스트 are all held to draws away from home.
웨스트햄 유나이티드's title hopes are hit by a 4–2 home defeat to 왓퍼드.

Despite losing 1–0 to 애스턴 빌라 in the semi-final second leg, 에버턴 are through to the League Cup final, securing them their first cup final for seven years and the first all-Merseyside final in any of the domestic or European cup competitions.

울버햄프턴 원더러스 are now 13 points adrift of safety after losing 4–0 to local rivals 애스턴 빌라 in the First Division at Villa Park. 리버풀 maintain a four-point lead at the top of the table, with 맨체스터 유나이티드's 2–1 home win over 선덜랜드 keeping up the pressure on the leaders. 노팅엄 포리스트's title hopes take another blow they lose 1–0 at home to 아스널. 웨스트햄 유나이티드 are now nine points behind the leaders after going down 1–0 at 노리치 시티. An eight-goal thriller at Vicarage Road sees 왓퍼드 and 에버턴 draw 4-4.
버밍엄 시티 go seven points clear of the relegation zone with a 2–1 home win over local rivals 웨스트브로미치 앨비언.

England's first international game since their failure to qualify for the European Championship Finals ends in a 2–0 defeat to France in the Parc des Princes . On the club scene, 리버풀 continue to top the First Division, with a four-point lead over 맨체스터 유나이티드. 노팅엄 포리스트, 웨스트햄 유나이티드 and 사우샘프턴 complete the top five. 울버햄프턴 원더러스 remain bottom of the table, 13 points adrift of safety with 14 games to go. 노츠 카운티 are 11 points adrift of safety, and 스토크 시티 complete the bottom three, just behind 웨스트브로미치 앨비언, 레스터 시티 and 입스위치 타운. 셰필드 웬즈데이 and 첼시 are level at the top of the Second Division, while 그림즈비 타운 have crept into the top three at the expense of 맨체스터 시티.
